about_the_game:
About This Game

The year is 3085, and game developers are the rockstars of the future. Creativity fuels entire worlds, and you’ve been invited to the heart of it all — a sprawling futuristic hub city where gamers and devs come together to play, create, and showcase their ideas.

This isn’t just a game — it’s a living community platform that grows with you.

  • Hang Out in the City
    Explore a glowing sci-fi hub, meet other players, and take part in weekly events and contests.

  • Play & Compete
    Join mini-games, challenges, and tournaments directly tied to the Devgames3085 YouTube channel, where updates, highlights, and winners are featured.

  • Shape the World
    Submit your own assets, levels, and characters through Discord. Approved content will be added to the game, meaning the city evolves with every community contribution. (All submissions must fit the 3085 futuristic aesthetic.)

  • Showcase Your Work
    Developers can feature their demos in special booths within the hub — giving players the chance to explore new creations and test fresh ideas.

Development Philosophy

The game will launch bare bones, but it will continually improve as the community grows. With every contest, update, and showcase tied to the Devgames3085 YouTube channel, the city becomes a living record of creativity — shaped by both players and developers.

Welcome to the future. Welcome to Devgames3085.

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: windows 10
  • Processor: i5
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1080
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
